notes: NAME RECONCILIATION: the workbook name 'Dr. Balachandran Palat' is this doctor under the Kerala naming convention in which the house/family name leads. Every public page renders him as 'Dr. P Balachandran Menon' / 'Dr. Palat Balachandran Menon' - a search on the exact phrase "Palat Balachandran Menon" returns his AIG, Practo, Skedoc, Credihealth and Sehat pages, confirming Palat is the P. Identity then matches on four assigned facts: specialty (Liver Transplant & Hepatobiliary Surgery), hospital (AIG Hospitals), branch (Gachibowli) and city (Hyderabad). AIG URL PATTERN FINDING (first AIG rows in this dataset - recorded for the ~360 AIG rows that follow): (a) YES, aighospitals.com does publish per-doctor profile pages, and they index well. (b) FOUR distinct URL families were observed verbatim in search results, so never construct one: [1] https://aighospitals.com/doctor/<dr-name-slug> - SINGULAR, the most common current form (seen: /doctor/dr-sumana-kolar-ramachandra, /doctor/dr-govindhu-b, /doctor/dr-upasna-c-bahure, /doctor/dr-gayathri-kolagatla, /doctor/dr-avinash-bonda, /doctor/dr-vivek-sreekanth, /doctor/dr-ravikiran-naalla, /doctor/dr-srinivas-reddy-v, /doctor/dr-koneru-vamsi-krishna, /doctor/dr-rama-krishna); [2] https://aighospitals.com/doctors/<dr-name-slug> - PLURAL, an older/parallel form still indexed and still serving live pages for some doctors, including THIS one (/doctors/dr-p-balachandran-menon) and /doctors/dr-vamshi-krishna, /doctors/dr-suresh-kanasani/ - but beware, some plural URLs are now dead (/doctors/dr-sridhar-dasu/ is indexed with the title '404 Page Not Found'); [3] https://aighospitals.com/doctor-profile/<dr-name-slug> (seen: /doctor-profile/dr-vamshi-krishna-m); [4] https://aighospitals.com/doctor-profile/<numeric-id> (seen: /doctor-profile/160, and /doctor-profile/110 which is a 404). Slug form is 'dr-' + full-name slug, sometimes carrying a trailing initial (dr-govindhu-b, dr-srinivas-reddy-v, dr-vamshi-krishna-m). Both aighospitals.com and www.aighospitals.com appear in the index. (c) The doctor-page pattern does NOT encode department, and normally does NOT encode branch. Specialty is exposed only as a NUMERIC query parameter on the listing pages: https://aighospitals.com/doctors?speciality=20 / =21 / =26 / =28. Branch DOES exist as an OPTIONAL leading path segment on some pages - '/gcb/' = Gachibowli, '/bh/' = Banjara Hills - confirmed on https://aighospitals.com/gcb/speciality/liver-transplant-hepatobiliary-surgery, https://aighospitals.com/bh/sub-speciality/hepatology, on a doctor page https://aighospitals.com/bh/doctor/dr-janarthan-babu-s, and on https://aighospitals.com/bh/doctor-search. Unprefixed speciality pages also exist (/speciality/multiorgan-transplants, /speciality/radiation-oncology, /speciality/surgical-gastroenterology, /speciality/urology-renal-transplant). PRACTICAL METHOD for later AIG rows: run WebSearch with allowed_domains=["aighospitals.com"] on the doctor's name plus specialty - that surfaced the canonical page reliably in all three of these rows; entry points are https://www.aighospitals.com/doctors and https://www.aighospitals.com/doctor-search. LINKEDIN CAVEAT: the recorded LinkedIn profile matches on name and on the rare subspecialty ('Consultant Liver Transplant Surgeon'), but its headline shows Medanta The Medicity - consistent with a prior post in his known career path, not with his current AIG role. A human should confirm currency before using it. CONTACTS: no email or phone for him appeared verbatim on any indexed page across four queries, so both are blank rather than derived from the aighospitals.com domain. VOLUME CAVEAT: the '2000' and 'almost 3000' liver transplant figures come from different secondary pages and conflict; both are quoted verbatim in hni_signals rather than reconciled or estimated. Band Medium: aighospitals.com is the single official source; LinkedIn is self-published and Practo/Skedoc/Credihealth/HexaHealth/Sehat/organstransplant/transplantliverinindia are corroborating-only.
